name: Axsix Milirose
source:
Axsix Milirose is the son of Mietwen and Gawloyes, and one of the many uncles of Haron, Ernol, Vadeyn and Calipoa. 

He is charming, courteous and quite easy to smile, something very at odds with the intensity with which he regards the world around him. Indeed, despite being relatively quiet and mild-mannered, his studious gaze leaves people rather unsettled. Nevertheless, Calipoa describes him as one of her more pleasant relatives.

As an assassin, Axsix has killed many people in his life and is a very good liar, though a schemer might perhaps be a just as fitting; an underhanded Milirose assassin operating from the shadows.(from official website)
